method: The 20 FAA AD to EASA AD pairs that round 31 drew with seed 20261122 (evidence/2026-11-22/awd_measure.json, handcheck_sample) were read today: the manufacturer and model in the FAA title and abstract against the type-certificate holder and type on the EASA tool page, and the defect in the FAA abstract against the EASA subject line. Nothing was fetched again for this check.
note: All 20 pairs name the same manufacturer and aircraft or engine type (Leonardo AW189 / AW189; Pilatus PC-24 / PC-24; Rolls-Royce Deutschland Trent 700 / RB211 TRENT 700). 5 EASA pages show only 'SUPERSEDED BY ...' as the subject, so the defect could not be compared. Of the other 15, 14 describe the same defect or action. One (FAA 2026-14-08 / EASA 2026-0125R1, Diamond DA 42) could not be confirmed from the 200 abstract characters kept: the FAA abstract speaks of uncommanded rudder deflection, the EASA subject of a nose landing gear actuator rod end.
